content.text: The only MFN-type provision in the document runs in our favour, so no redline is needed.

input.quote: TrueLink agrees that the costs for any Hosting Services will not increase for a period of one year from the date of this Agreement and that rates charged for Hosting Services will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party.
input.rationale: The sole most-favoured-nation style provision (Section 6, in the COMPENSATION section) runs in our favour: TrueLink undertakes that Hosting Services rates will not exceed those charged to any other party, coupled with a one-year price freeze. Nothing in the compensation, license, or client covenant provisions obliges Mortgage Logic.com to extend TrueLink terms no less favourable than those given to third parties or to match third-party offers. Consistent with the rule's direction test, a Vendor-granted MFN is welcome and is not redlined.
